envelope.description: Add the tools.commonApproval setting and retire permissions.mode

body.title: Add the tools.commonApproval setting and retire permissions.mode
body.summary: Add the tools.commonApproval enum entry (manual, edit-auto, auto; default auto) to src/config/config-catalog.ts with a reader the executor uses per call (an unknown value falls back to auto with a warning). Retire permissions.mode through RETIRED_PATHS and remove its type use in src/shared/types.ts, its insrc.permissions.mode contribution in vscode-plugin/package.json and its entry in site/settings.html; remove the unread approval.defaultAction and destructive.requireDoubleConfirm from src/daemon/tools/config.ts. Update the tests and fixture that assert the old state (config-catalog-contract, config-boot-reconcile, config-reconcile-smoke, daemon-defaults-literal.json and its PROVENANCE.md).
acceptanceChecks: a fresh config gets tools.commonApproval = auto from the boot reconcile and a written value survives a reload
an unknown value reads as auto and logs a warning
permissions.mode is stripped from an existing config on reconcile and appears nowhere in the catalog, the plugin manifest or the settings page
the tests that asserted permissions.mode now assert its absence and pass
no remaining reader of approval.defaultAction or destructive.requireDoubleConfirm

tests.name: src/config/__tests__/tools-common-approval.test.ts: config catalog entry tools.commonApproval: default auto, an unknown value falls back to auto with a warning, and a value written to config.json is read back after a reload
src/config/__tests__/tools-common-approval.test.ts: permissions.mode is stripped from an existing config and is gone from the catalog, the plugin manifest and the settings page
